name: gta-vi-road-ep5-gta-iii-to-vi
lines:
في 2001 جاءت GTA III
إلى Liberty City

ثم GTA IV في 2008
و GTA V في 2013
تعود إلى Vice City في GTA VI
headline:
ربع قرن
من GTA III إلى GTA VI
label: رسمي

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: release years from Take-Two's 10-K filings (FY2002, FY2004, FY2008, FY2014; newsroom/context/gta-series-history.md) and Rockstar's game pages: GTA III 2001, Vice City 2002, San Andreas 2004, GTA IV 29 Apr 2008, GTA V 17 Sep 2013; GTA VI 19 Nov 2026 (rockstargames.com/VI, read 11 Nov)
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: no series-history Reel in the ledger since episode 1 (numbers)
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: hook a quarter century from GTA III to VI; why now 4 days to launch; for players here where VI comes from; payoff the return to Vice City after 13 years
reel_check.STORY TYPE numbers: yes: years only, each from a filing; no figure card (the batch keeps its one numbers card unused)
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: «ربع قرن من GTA III إلى GTA VI. في 2001 جاءت GTA III إلى Liberty City، وفي 2002 انتقلت إلى Vice City، وفي 2004 جاءت San Andreas، ثم GTA IV في 2008 و GTA V في 2013. وبعد أكثر من 13 عامًا تعود إلى Vice City في GTA VI.» No line opens on و
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: no bare تصل; جاءت and تعود describe the series, not a release date
reel_check.STORY: names: yes: games and places in English; و spaced before GTA V on screen
reel_check.SENSITIVE: yes, handled: no weapons fired, no casino or club shots, no swimwear; GTA IV has no official footage on an allowed route, so it is named over GTA V footage and the credit says so
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: yes: our gtavi bed: the Reel crosses three trailers (2014 GTA V, 2021 Trilogy, 2026 GTA VI) and the Trilogy trailer has speech throughout, so no one stretch fits (trailer-sound rule, 23 Oct: our bed with the reason)
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: Rockstar's own trailers for each era, each credited with its year
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same picture as the las: yes: picture: GTA V Sandy Shores (2014 trailer 15.4); not in the last five
reel_check.PICTURE: credit on every clip: yes: shots 0 to 12 (Rockstar Games; the longer credits naming the 2014 trailer and the 2021 edition ran out of the safe zone, so the story file names them)
